additional_info.body:
Dear Florent
Following that request, I want to let you know that the 300 you can see refers to the limit of the outlet — it appears just under the outlets. It does
not
relate to the AC, because that’s not the case. There’s nothing that needs to be configured in the SCB for it to appear on your screen.
With best regards,
Younes Baroudi
eMobility Technical Support Team
